explanation: The theorem says that for coprime P and M₁, any g in SL(2,ℤ) has a g₁ with the same reduction mod P and trivial reduction mod M₁. I grepped Mathlib for SL₂ reduction maps to ZMod, CRT lemmas combined with SpecialLinearGroup, surjectivity of SpecialLinearGroup.map, `exists_crt`, and Gamma/Coprime combinations. In this Mathlib, `CongruenceSubgroups.lean` has only the definition of the reduction map, and I found no surjectivity or CRT result for SL₂(ℤ). The surjectivity lemma `ModularCurve.surjective_specialLinearGroup_map_zmod`, which the proof uses, is not in this Mathlib. The proof is a substantial explicit construction and is not a short instantiation of any Mathlib declaration.
